formula: \mathrm{GBM}:\ a=\mu X,\ b=\sigma X;\quad\mathrm{OU}:\ a=\kappa(\theta-X),\ b=\sigma

note.ja: 決定論的初期値のスカラーSDE。平均・二次モーメントの弱誤差、共有Brown運動での強誤差、有限標本のMCSEを分けます。OUは調和Langevin系の浴成分に関連する追加検査です。
note.en: Scalar SDEs with deterministic initial states. Separate weak moment bias,strong errors on shared Brownian paths and finite-sample MCSE. OU is a related bath-component check,not the full harmonic Langevin system.

equation_note.en: The Hamiltonian link identifies the harmonic mechanical part; the calculations add friction/noise or a CSVR heat bath.

name.ja: Langevin温度制御：正準分布・刻み偏り・時間相関
name.en: Langevin thermostat: canonical distributions, timestep bias and correlation

scope.ja: 調和振動子のBAOABを、正準分布と離散Lyapunov定常分布、連続・離散の時間相関へ照合します。
scope.en: Compare harmonic BAOAB with canonical and discrete-Lyapunov stationary distributions, and with continuous/discrete time correlations.

assumptions.ja: 質量・Boltzmann定数・角振動数・摩擦・温度は1。独立32768複製、burn時間20、刻み0.4/0.2/0.1、相関lag時間2。h*omega<2を要求します。
assumptions.en: Mass, Boltzmann constant, frequency, friction and temperature are one. Use 32768 replicas, burn time 20, steps 0.4/0.2/0.1 and correlation lag 2; require h*omega<2.

limits.ja: 調和ポテンシャル・固定seedの分布検証です。位置分散が正確でも運動量には有限刻み偏りがあります。他のサーモスタット、一般分子系、長時間の第一原理MDへ検証を移しません。
limits.en: Distribution checks use a harmonic potential and fixed seeds. Exact position variance does not remove finite-step momentum bias. Evidence does not transfer to other thermostats, general molecules or long ab initio MD.

reference_note.ja: SciPy離散Lyapunov解および調和系の明示共分散diag(T/omega²,T(1-h²omega²/4))で照合。運動量の刻み2次偏りと有限標本誤差を分離し、burn過渡を写像で評価。連続相関は別の行列指数で算出します。
reference_note.en: Check against a SciPy discrete-Lyapunov solve and explicit harmonic covariance diag(T/omega²,T(1-h²omega²/4)). Separate second-order momentum bias from sampling error and evaluate burn transients from the map. A separate matrix exponential gives continuous correlation.

name.ja: CSVRとLangevin：調和2自由度の分布・揺らぎ・相関
name.en: CSVR versus Langevin: distributions, fluctuations and correlations of two harmonic modes

scope.ja: 異なる周波数を持つ2自由度でglobal CSVRとlocal Langevinを同じOBABO分割で比較。位置・運動量・温度・全エネルギーの分布、揺らぎ、相関を記録します。
scope.en: Compare global CSVR with local Langevin on two nondegenerate modes using the same OBABO splitting. Record position, momentum, temperature and total-energy distributions, fluctuations and correlations.

assumptions.en: m=kB=T=1, omega=(1,1.7), Nf=2. tau=0.25/1, h=0.1/0.05. Evolve 8192 canonically initialized replicas and a separate 4096-replica ensemble with q,p scaled by 1.4 to t=20. Correlation lags are 0/0.5/1/2/4.

limits.ja: global CSVRとlocal Langevinの運動相関が等しいとは要求しません。CDF差は指定5点の最大であり全実数上のKS距離ではありません。正準初期分布の保存と温度摂動からの有限時間確認は一般のエルゴード性証明ではなく、軸上の励起されない自由度が残る反例もテストします。分子・拘束・BOMDには外挿しません。
limits.en: Global-CSVR and local-Langevin dynamical correlations are not required to agree. CDF errors are maxima over five declared points, not whole-line KS distances. Canonical-start preservation and the heated-start finite-time check do not prove ergodicity; tests retain an invariant unexcited-axis counterexample. No extrapolation to molecules, constraints or BOMD.

reference_note.ja: 正準Gaussian・Gamma分布とK/U/Hの平均・分散を照合。有限刻みではVerletのshadow二次形式を使い、位置分散T/[ω²(1−h²ω²/4)]、運動量分散Tを別導出したLyapunov解と比較します。h=0.2/0.1/0.05の決定論的偏りで2次性を確認。Langevinのq,p,K,H相関は独立の離散伝播と照合し、CSVRの相関は独立複製の標準誤差とτ・h依存を表示します。
reference_note.en: Check canonical Gaussian/Gamma distributions and K/U/H means/variances. For finite steps, compare the Verlet-shadow position variance T/[omega²(1−h² omega²/4)] and momentum variance T against a separately constructed Lyapunov solution. Deterministic biases at h=0.2/0.1/0.05 establish second order. Check Langevin q,p,K,H correlations against independent discrete propagation; report CSVR correlations with independent-replica standard errors and tau/h dependence.

name.ja: OUのweakモーメントと同時Brownian結合
name.en: OU weak moments with joint Brownian coupling

scope.ja: 連続真値、離散EM期待値、同一経路差とMCSEを分離する固定入力です。
scope.en: Separate continuous truth,exact discrete EM expectation,paired-path weak difference and MCSE.

assumptions.ja: dX=1.5(.2-X)dt+.8dW,X0=.7。無次元T=1、8/16/32/64刻み、独立32seed×1024経路。状態軸に境界・clipなし。

limits.ja: 弱誤差は期待値の差です。3SEや区間を真の誤差上界・一般被覆保証としません。1D状態×時間の保存例であり2D物理流れではありません。GBMやOU浴成分を新しい物理問題として重複計数しません。
limits.en: Weak error is a difference of expectations. SE/intervals are not true-error bounds or general coverage guarantees. State×time examples are not2Dphysical flow. Existing GBM/OUbath physical families are reused.

reference_note.ja: 軌道前にDecimal80/120・独立GH/OU共分散積分とpaired分散による標本解像を資格。各モーメントの5MCSE校正、MCSE精度、固定3段weak率、最後2段の3SE解像を判定。区間の被覆は離散真値に対する有限32反復の記述値。
reference_note.en: Before paths qualify Decimal80/120,independent GH/OUcovariance integrals and paired-variance allocation. Gate5MCSE calibration,MCSE precision,fixed three-level weak rate and final-two-level3SE resolution. Coverage is descriptive over32batches against discrete truth.
